mapper.select: SELECT setting_id AS settingId, setting_key AS settingKey, setting_name AS settingName, setting_value AS settingValue, description, is_editable AS isEditable, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sd_system_setting WHERE setting_key = #{settingKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE sd_system_setting SET setting_value = #{settingValue}, updated_at = now() WHERE setting_key = #{settingKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sd_system_setting_config_log ( admin_user_id, setting_key, before_value, after_value, description ) VALUES ( #{adminUserId}, #{settingKey}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{description} )
mapper.select: SELECT setting_id AS settingId, setting_key AS settingKey, setting_name AS settingName, setting_value AS settingValue, description, is_editable AS isEditable, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sd_system_setting ORDER BY setting_id ASC

SELECT sscl.log_id AS logId, sscl.admin_user_id AS adminUserId, sscl.setting_key AS settingKey, sscl.before_value AS beforeValue, sscl.after_value AS afterValue, sscl.description AS description, sscl.created_at AS createdAt, su.username AS adminUsername FROM sd_system_setting_config_log sscl LEFT JOIN sd_user su ON sscl.admin_user_id = su.user_id ORDER BY sscl.log_id DESC
